theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_one_dim_minimizing_cone
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → ∃ (e : Euclid P) (m : ℕ), (0 < m → ‖e‖ = 1) ∧ C.support ⊆ (Submodule.span ℝ {e} : Set (Euclid P)) ∧ ∀ y ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {e}, HasMassDensity C y m
